mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, website_token, enabled, display_name, logo_url, welcome_message, theme_color, position, allowed_domains, ai_enabled, offline_message, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_webchat_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM crm_webchat_config WHERE website_token = #{websiteToken} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_webchat_config ( tenant_id, website_token, enabled, display_name, logo_url, welcome_message, theme_color, position, allowed_domains, ai_enabled, offline_message, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{websiteToken}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1), #{displayName}, #{logoUrl}, #{welcomeMessage}, #{themeColor}, COALESCE(#{position}, 'bottom-right'), COALESCE(#{allowedDomains}, '[]'), COALESCE(#{aiEnabled}, 0), #{offlineMessage}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, logo_url = EXCLUDED.logo_url, welcome_message = EXCLUDED.welcome_message, theme_color = EXCLUDED.theme_color, position = EXCLUDED.position, allowed_domains = EXCLUDED.allowed_domains, ai_enabled = EXCLUDED.ai_enabled, offline_message = EXCLUDED.offline_message, update_by = EXCLUDED.update_by, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_webchat_config SET website_token = #{websiteToken}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
